site.costs: Results are computed from entry and exit prices in the trade log. Brokerage, statutory charges, taxes and slippage are not deducted.

strategies.name: Elysium
strategies.tagline: Hedged Nifty option spreads at full size
strategies.summary: Elysium runs Firefly's hedged option-selling rules on Nifty weekly options at the largest position size of the three. Every short option is paired with a bought hedge, so the loss on each position is limited when it is opened.

strategies.name: Ember
strategies.tagline: The same rules for a ₹10 lakh account
strategies.summary: Ember applies Firefly's hedged option-selling rules on Nifty weekly options to a ₹10 lakh account, combining intraday, overnight and weekly-direction entries. Every short option is paired with a bought hedge.

strategies.name: Mirage
strategies.summary: Mirage sells Nifty weekly option spreads further from the market price, collecting a smaller premium per trade in exchange for shallower drawdowns. Every short option is paired with a bought hedge.
